adaptations.password-reset: Taken as the CRM kit adapted it: the starter's reset-request and reset actions own the proofs, delivery goes only through the platform email module (lib/email.ts), and the panel and its words are kept, with the help line changed to the business that sent the invite. Signed-in password change is not shipped. Version 0.1.0 is the kit's snapshot label; the registry has no version field.
adaptations.theme: Taken as the CRM kit adapted it: fonts from bundled npm packages in the starter's layout and theme.css, no remote font imports.
